subject: leaflet addRasterImage - transparent coloring not working

messages.author: 1d4acdbf5cf24581
messages.subject: leaflet addRasterImage - transparent coloring not working
parts:
Hi all

I have a RasterLayer object with mostly NA values for my shiny-leaflet application. A subset of this RasterLayer contains values.

Unfortuantely, the NAs are not treated as being transparent when plotted using leaflet within shiny. Does someone know why the NA points are also colored and not treated as being transparent?

I am using the expression "renderLeaflet" in the server.R file to display my data:

    output$generalmap_rent<-
renderLeaflet({
      m_rent<-leaflet::leaflet()
      m_rent<-setView(m_rent,lng=9....,lat=47.....,zoom=12)
      m_rent<-addTiles(m_rent)
      pal<-colorNumeric("Reds", c(50,400),na.color="transparent")
      m_rent<-addRasterImage(m_rent,raster_nb_rent2, colors = pal, opacity = 0.5)

      m_rent<-addLegend(m_rent,position="topleft",pal,values=values(raster_nb_rent2),title=cat("estimation"))
      m_rent
     })


My RasterLayer object has the following entries:

raster_nb_rent2
class       : RasterLayer
dimensions  : 565, 591, 333915  (nrow, ncol, ncell)
resolution  : 0.000657, 0.00045  (x, y)
extent      : 9..., 9...., 46....., 47....  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
coord. ref. : +proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +ellps=WGS84 +towgs84=0,0,0
data source : in memory
names       : var1.pred
values      : 85.10788, 359.8369  (min, max)


Thanks for your help.

messages.subject: Re: leaflet addRasterImage - transparent coloring not working
parts: Hmmm, can you try replacing "transparent" with "rgba(0,0,0,0)"? I don't think "transparent" is a valid CSS color.
